text:
Emma Chen: FYI - Caraway production embeddings dropped ~98% overnight. Total calls down ~60% W/W. Looks like procurement hunt.
Jordan Lee: Oof. Is there a people change? That often precedes a shortlisting.
Emma Chen: Yes, Priya (ML lead) left 2 weeks ago. New PM Abe is running vendor evals and flagged cost as top priority in the intake doc.
Sophie Patel: Can someone share a quick breakdown by route/model? If embeddings are gone but generate calls remain, that points to a specific feature being cut.
Carlos Mendes: Quick numbers from metrics API: 
```
7d: calls=390 (prev=980, -60%)
embeddings=6 (prev=480, -99%)
/top routes: /v1/embed (down 99%), /v1/generate (down 28%)
median latency ~ steady
```
Jordan Lee: That aligns with procurement note about "embed cost"—vendor X advertises per-embed discounts.
Sophie Patel: Proposed actions: 1) One-pager: cost levers (batching, caching, quantization) + expected % savings for embed-heavy workloads. 2) Offer 90-day Dedicated trial with guaranteed capacity and price cap. 3) SolutionsEng mapping session to show integration lift.
Emma Chen: I'll reach out to Abe and schedule a 30-min call tomorrow. Need to keep this low-friction.
Jordan Lee: @Carlos can you assemble a side-by-side unit cost calc (Redwood vs Vendor X) and show savings if they enable prefix KV caching + 4-bit quantization? Procurement will want numbers.
Carlos Mendes: On it. ETA EOD Tuesday. I'll include token-level unit, estimate of cache hit rate impact, and sample cost curves for typical embed batch sizes.
Sophie Patel: I'll draft the one-pager and a 3-slide deck for AE. If we can show 25-40% TCO improvement on their telemetry, procurement might deprioritize the RFP.
Emma Chen: CS note: customer asked for "lower ops burden" proof. Add a migration checklist and estimated SE hours (and who from our side runs migration).
renewal-bot: Follow-up scheduled 2026-03-25 10:00 for Caraway check-in :calendar:
Abe (Caraway): Thanks Emma. Will join the call tomorrow. Cost is our biggest blocker.
Jordan Lee: Good. Expectation: brief tech deep-dive + cost model. If we can offer trial capacity + SE runbook, strong chance to keep them.
Emma Chen: Plan: Carlos posts cost comparison by EOD Tue; Sophie shares one-pager by Wed AM; Emma runs call tomorrow and collects procurement asks.
Sophie Patel: I'll loop in SalesOps for any concession approvals and capture concession types we can offer (trial credits, temporary price cap, free SE hours).
Carlos Mendes: Posting snippet of a tiny calc I use to estimate per-embed cost quickly:
```
# rough embed cost
embeds_per_month = 600000
price_per_embed = 0.00075  # example
monthly = embeds_per_month * price_per_embed
```
Emma Chen: Thanks team. Marking as renewal-watch. I'll update after the call with Abe. :eyes:
